digest.component_or_area: rebar tracker-footprint command and store measurement module
propositions: Add an explicit, opt-in, read-only `rebar tracker-footprint` command that measures configured tracker footprint without running implicitly during ticket writes, reconciliation, gates, or metrics

Command must separately report packed object bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes (when st_blocks available), file count, allocation slack, Git-directory bytes, and whole-clone bytes

Default mode measures the mounted tracker and identifies shared object databases; --fresh-clone mode creates a temporary unfiltered single-branch clone with hardlink optimization disabled, measures it, and removes only command-owned temporary state

JSON output must validate against tracker_footprint.schema.json and include measured ref/tip, definitions, and values with structured unavailable markers for unsupported allocation accounting on platforms lacking st_blocks

Platform edge case: st_blocks-absent systems report structured allocation-unavailable values while preserving exact logical metrics, and linked worktrees are labeled with shared object scope rather than standalone-clone cost

Failure modes must clean up only command-owned temporary state and exit nonzero without emitting a success report for invalid remote or branch; no size-based threshold, pass/fail classification, or nonzero exit caused solely by large results
